Is the GTA slowing? September's numbers.

TRREB reported 5,040 GTA home sales in September 2026, down 9% from September 2025. caption:
Rate hike odds just jumped. Your payment?

The Bank of Canada decides Wednesday, Oct 28 (policy rate now 2.25%).
- Reuters poll: 19 of 34 economists expect a hike to 2.50%; markets moved from about a 30% chance to roughly three in four.
- Not everyone agrees: some economists, incl. National Bank's Stéfane Marion, argue against a hike now.
- Variable rate: a 0.25% hike adds about $13/month per $100K of mortgage (example 3.43% to 3.68%, 25-year amortization; on $500K that's about $66/month).
- Fixed rate: no change until renewal; fixed rates follow bond yields. Buying or renewing? Ask your lender about a rate hold.
- Selling: national sales were down 7.7% year over year in September; price from recent sold homes.

Sources: Reuters poll, Oct 23, 2026; MoneySense, Oct 22, 2026; Canadian Mortgage Professional, Oct 26, 2026; CREA (Sept 2026 data).

Raise, hold or cut? Comment your guess below.

Comment INFO to get full details, or call 905-452-4298.

Forecasts can change. Not financial or mortgage advice.

Voiceover: AI-generated in Krishna's own voice.

Krishna Rander, Realtor® | PROPERTY.CA INC., Brokerage
